headlines.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Is Weeks Away. Is Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) Still a Buy at a Discount?
headlines.summary: A video game company sitting on the most anticipated release in years would seem to deserve a premium price tag. Yet Take-Two Interactive Software (NASDAQ:TTWO) trades at a lower multiple than it has averaged over the past five years, with Grand Theft Auto VI only weeks away.

headlines.title: Take-Two Interactive Slides 5% as Wells Fargo Trims Estimates Behind $300 Target; Roblox Holds Flat, GameStop Barely Budges
headlines.summary: Wells Fargo kept its bullish rating on Take-Two even as it slashed near-term estimates, and the reasoning behind that contradiction reveals just how much is riding on a single game release.

headlines.title: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. to Report Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Results on Monday, November 9, 2026
headlines.summary: NEW YORK, October 13, 2026--Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO) today announced that it plans to report financial results for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027, ended September 30, 2026, after the market close on Monday, November 9, 2026. The Company plans to hold a conference call to discuss its results at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, which can be accessed by dialing (833) 461-5787 (Meeting ID: 112-490-011).

headlines.title: Solana Meme Coin Tied To GTA 6 Leaker Jumps After Threat To Release Full Game Build
headlines.summary: GTA 6 is Take-Two’s most anticipated release and is set to launch Nov. 19, after being pushed back from May 26.

description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. develops, publishes, and markets interactive entertainment solutions for consumers worldwide. The company develops and publishes action/adventure products under the Grand Theft Auto, LA Noire, Max Payne, Midnight Club, and Red Dead Redemption names, as well as other franchises. It also publishes various entertainment properties across various platforms and a range of genres, such as shooter, action, role-playing, strategy, sports, and family/casual entertainment under the BioShock, Mafia, Sid Meier's Civilization, XCOM series, Borderlands, and Tiny Tina's Wonderland names. In addition, the company publishes sports simulation titles comprising NBA 2K series, a basketball video game; the WWE 2K professional wrestling series; mobile titles, including WWE SuperCard; and PGA TOUR 2K. Further, it offers free-to-play mobile games, such as CSR Racing, Dragon City, Empires & Puzzles, FarmVille 3, Game of Thrones: Legends, Golf Rival, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells, Hit It Rich!, Match Factory!, Merge Dragons!, Merge Magic!, Monster Legends, NBA 2K, Toon Blast, Top Eleven, Wizard Of Oz Slots Casino, Toy Blast, Words With Friends, and Zynga Poker; and Color Block Jam. The company's products are designed for console gaming systems; and mobiles, such as smartphones, tablets, and personal computers. It provides its products through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New York, New York.
